categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Xinyuren Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of high-end intelligent manufacturing equipment, primarily for lithium-ion battery production. Its product portfolio includes lithium battery drying equipment, coating equipment, roller pressing and slitting equipment, cell assembly lines, hydrogen fuel cell equipment, and optical film roll-to-roll manufacturing equipment. The company also operates in new materials, key components, and automation solutions for lithium batteries, photovoltaics, and hydrogen fuel cells.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as vacuum drying, high-precision coating with servo control, digital slitting, and integrated roller pressing and slitting machines. It has developed proprietary technologies including rapid heating and vacuum insulation, multi-point differential flow control for coating, high-precision laser thickness measurement, and intelligent drying systems. The R&D system integrates equipment, process, and new materials, focusing on innovations like dry electrode equipment for solid-state batteries and halide solid electrolytes. Manufacturing involves both customized and standardized production, with in-house and outsourced component fabrication.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading lithium battery manufacturers, including top-tier companies like CATL and BYD, serving the electric vehicle, energy storage, and consumer electronics sectors. The company also extends its solutions to photovoltaic and hydrogen fuel cell industries. Its products cater to battery manufacturers requiring high-end automation and precision equipment for battery electrode production, assembly, and testing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with headquarters and major production facilities in Shenzhen and subsidiaries in cities like Huizhou, Dongguan, Shanghai, and Huainan. Domestic sales dominate, with a small portion of revenue from overseas markets. The company benefits from the dense industrial ecosystem of the Pearl River Delta region.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xinyuren operates mainly in the midstream segment of the lithium battery supply chain, manufacturing high-end production equipment and key components used by battery manufacturers. It also engages in upstream R&D of new materials and downstream assembly line solutions, positioning itself as a comprehensive equipment and technology provider within the lithium battery manufacturing ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment, dedicating over 11% of revenue to innovation focused on equipment, processes, and new materials. Strategic R&D directions include multi-layer high-speed coating technologies, dry electrode equipment for solid-state batteries, halide solid electrolytes, and large cylindrical battery assembly lines. It also emphasizes digital transformation through smart factory initiatives and integrated digital platforms. Collaborations with universities and industry partners support cutting-edge technology development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized and standardized high-end manufacturing equipment, key components, and automation solutions. The company also earns income from providing integrated battery production line solutions and after-sales technical services. Sales are predominantly contract-based with milestone payments tied to order signing, delivery, installation, and acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Xinyuren is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer of lithium battery production equipment with strong R&D capabilities and a differentiated product portfolio. It competes with other Chinese high-end equipment makers and international suppliers. The company has established partnerships with industry leaders like CATL and BYD, enhancing its market credibility. It holds numerous patents and industry awards, reinforcing its competitive edge in technology and innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 621.8 million, a 4.75% increase year-over-year, but incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 63.26 million due to margin pressure and increased impairment provisions. Total assets grew by over 10% to RMB 2.04 billion, with net assets around RMB 820 million. The company maintains a strong R&D investment ratio and is expanding production capacity, though it faces challenges from industry overcapacity and market competition.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xinyuren emphasizes its integrated 'high-end equipment + process + new materials' innovation model, delivering comprehensive intelligent manufacturing solutions tailored to customer needs. Its products feature advanced automation, high precision, energy efficiency, and reliability, addressing industry pain points such as electrode uniformity and production efficiency. The company’s strong patent portfolio, continuous product optimization, and dedicated technical service teams provide customers with differentiated value and support for smart factory transformation.
